'''J'fe Din''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who became famous for her [[Holovid/Legends|holovid series]] [[Starflash (holovid series)|''Starflash'']]. The series was actually a means of transmitting codes, passwords and messages to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents working in [[Larrin sector/Legends|Larrin sector]] and it managed to quickened the downfall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] by at least a year in the sector.
